name: LeakIX
tagline: Open-index API for leaked services, misconfigured hosts, and credential-exposure findings
description: LeakIX provides a search API over an open index of internet-facing services, misconfigurations, and credential-exposure findings. Developers can query hosts, services, and leak data for security research, threat hunting, and exposure monitoring. Authentication is typically API-key based; free-tier and rate limits should be verified from official docs before production use.

auth.details: API key authentication (details to verify from official docs; often header-based)

use_cases: search for exposed services by technology or product
find hosts with known misconfigurations or open databases
look up leak/credential exposure findings for a domain or host
monitor attack surface for newly indexed exposed services
